change: One bounded repair round may split before dispatch into at most three independently budgeted requests. Required original citations and coverage-hinted sources retain their quotes and existing bounded context before optional candidates are fitted.
invariants: No increase to 24KB per-request limit, call/token pools, wall clock or verification reserve.
Preflight every planned batch before any model send. An atomic hypothesis/analysis batch cannot split to bypass a capacity failure.
True accepted definitions and unverified sibling drafts are labelled separately. Sibling content is not factual evidence or a newly approved result.
Each target can be revised only in its assigned batch, retaining original kind, role, obligation IDs and permitted source versions. Local evidence aliases restore separately per batch.
Persist input digest, ordered targets, original request limit and each completed batch draft. Reopening skips completed batches; the tracked ledger blocks unknown pending calls.
Actual budgets are still atomically checked before each send. Budget or later request-capacity exhaustion retains completed drafts for independent verification.
All accumulated revisions pass the existing independent verifier and consistency gates together before publication.
Only exact repeated role requirements are factored; all common scientific requirements remain. Output schemas cover writable target roles; sibling definitions remain intact.

offlineReplay.boundary: Purely prospective hypothesis/analysis targets had no factual citations or additional source permission. This capture used empty simulated revisions: new model drafts may enlarge later sibling context and are re-admitted before dispatch. No generated-content quality is established by this replay.

limitations: Some inputs can still exceed capacity as an indivisible target; they stop before sending.
Available budget or time may permit fewer than three requests; the round does not guarantee a complete repair.
Real model output and final DR0-DR5 acceptance remain unverified for this version.
